Reference for /compact: input table, message table, composing snippet, and the lifecycle/correlation model (command/run + command/done log-only, sourceEventSeq correlation, quiescent teardown, process-scoped busy).
Chinese translation of the /compact reference; keeps the English user-facing message strings literal because the backend emits them verbatim; Dev Note names queued commands as an undecided direction.

Plugin entry: registers /compact, rejects arguments, maps ManualCompactionError codes to stable human sentences, and drains in-flight handlers before unregistering (ctx.effect yield drain before ctx.commands.register).

Tests registration (Loader-safe named exports, no default), result texts, the six error-code messages, cancellation precedence, and that disposal does not settle until an aborted handler's close and flush boundaries pass.

Proves /compact is discovered and executed through the real Loader with a third-party backend (@test/compact-backend), asserting the whole ordered event list command/run -> compaction/start -> summary -> end -> command/done and sourceCommandId propagation.

24-line project config; references only cosmokit, cordis, interaction/commands and ../compaction — no core/agent, because the agent is reached only through the seam's structural ManualCompactAgentContext type.

Chinese locale: title 上下文压缩 plus a one-line user-facing description of threshold-triggered summarization.
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic v0.2.1-rc.2; the pruner is an OPTIONAL peer dependency (peerDependenciesMeta) so the backend stays independently composable.
Per-section bilingual hash record; the model-facing compaction-instruction code block is hashed as its own section so the template is gated against translation drift.

Full backend reference: the four design commitments (one measurement service, log-recorded bracket as transaction, warm-prefix reuse, summarize() as sole subclass hook), the tuning table, trigger/overflow mechanics, region transaction, and an explicit Model-Experience section with token and KV-cache effects.
Chinese translation of the backend reference; keeps the eight-section compaction instruction verbatim in English because the model consumes that literal text.

Load-time config validation, per-routed-model policy merging, and capacity scaling: thresholdTokens = floor(min(W x ratio, W - reservedOutput - headroom)), retention as a fraction of (W - O); unknown keys and duplicate policies rejected at load.

Plugin entry: BasicCompactionEngine with agent/pre-step pressure and agent/request-error overflow listeners, the durable-routed-target policy resolution, the summarizer target fallback chain, and the manual compactNow path (runMaintenance admission, turn:null bracket, flush before release).

Heart of the backend: selectCompactableRange (never shadows the system head, rounds the cut head-ward to a tool-pairing-balanced boundary) and the bracket-first compactSurfaceRegion transaction with whole-surface vs selected-span stability checks, the route-price shrink check, and the shadow-price protocol.

Default one-shot ctx.llm.stream() summarizer: replays the conversation prefix, appends the fixed eight-section instruction as the FINAL user message for KV-cache reuse, frames the checkpoint with <compacted-summary> tags, and fails closed on max-tokens, error, aborted, empty text, or image output.
Config/resolved-policy vocabulary; ResolvedRetention is a discriminated union with never on the other arm so exactly one retention form is a compile-time property.

Main backend suite (2,321 lines): config resolution, pressure/retention, optional pruner, region transaction, default summarizer (pins the cache-reuse prefix equality), automatic listeners, and route-priced image pressure proving the two-price discipline.

Real-loop regressions: CBR-001 (a checkpoint is a balanced cut on both sides), post-step pressure ordering (tool/result < step/end < compaction/start < next step), prompt-admission token accounting, and overflow recovery for thrown vs in-band provider errors with independent retry budgets.

Real Cordis Loader composition from a temp cordis.yml; asserts every plugin actually loaded and that stale config keys (models:, contextWindow), merged ratio conflicts, and incomplete summarization pairs are rejected at plugin load.

Manual /compact path through the real AgentLoop: admission and ordering (compaction/start:null -> summary -> end -> flush -> next turn), every ManualCompactionError code, the durable-stale-orphan rule proven from three angles (end-seed, fork seed, repaired turn state), and pre-aborted-signal precedence.

Single end-to-end regression: runtime-context snapshots (injected cwd) are re-admitted into the first request after a proactive compaction; the compaction shadowed the original snapshot and exactly two snapshots exist afterwards.
Project config with references to llm/token-meter, core/agent, interaction/commands, ../compaction and ../compaction-tool-result-pruner; include:["src"] excludes tests from the declaration build.

Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-image-offload v0.2.1-rc.2; exports ./projection separately for offline/detached readers; no schemastery dependency because the plugin has no configuration.
Per-section bilingual hash record; the whole implementation prose hashes as one block because that page has no sub-headings under understand-the-implementation.

Reference for the image-offload executor: the image/offload decision event, IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED handling, that the retry spends no provider retry budget and logs no llm/retry event, and the three named limitations (never returns, costs a failed attempt, a temporary small budget offloads permanently).
Chinese translation; keeps IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED/offloadImages in English inside Chinese prose; Dev Note records the planned shift to provider-reported uncacheable images.

Selects and durably records the oldest retained input-image occurrences to omit, walking sourceEventSeqs in model-request order; indexes count every occurrence including already-offloaded ones, so numbering is a stable address rather than a live counter.

Plugin entry: registers the message projection and installs the agent/request-error and compaction/summary-error recovery listeners; the retry is a durable surface repair that spends no retry budget and logs no llm/retry event.
Pure immutable application of one offload decision: copy-on-write content rebuild, same message identity, unselected blocks reference-equal, throws on an already-offloaded or non-existent index.

Browser-safe durable image-selection declaration and pure replay definition; atomic total validation (malformed event rejected wholesale, never partially applied) and a @messageProjection so the logged message is never mutated.

End-to-end offload tests through the real agent loop and the real compaction summary path (using the production DeepSeek inlineImages byte check at a 1-byte budget); covers cancellation before/after a committed decision, changed selection, exhaustion, and plugin disposal.

Projection tests: identity preservation, the same selections reconstructed through pure folding, resume, restore and fork, 17 malformed payloads each rejected at append/replay/fold without partial application, and contentGeneration (not replaceGeneration) bumping on a content projection.
Project config; references ../compaction, llm/llm, core/session, core/agent and util/values, but NOT llm/token-meter — the executor prices nothing.

Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner v0.2.1-rc.2; runtime deps are only dsh-util-values and schemastery (dsh-compaction is a type-only peer for the compaction/prune event).
Per-section bilingual hash record; design-philosophy and pruning-mechanics hashed separately so the three stated commitments are gated independently.

Reference for the model-free pruner: the size-limit table, deterministic one-pass convergence, replay-safe replacement, the shadow-price protocol, and the explicit statement that character budgets are not token budgets.
Chinese translation; keeps the PRUNE_MARKER literal in English because the model sees it; repeats the grapheme-cluster limitation.

PRUNE_MARKER, defaults (8192/4096/1024), codePointLength via Array.from, and config validation including the invariant headChars + marker + tailChars <= thresholdChars so a valid config can never grow a result.

ToolResultPruner service: measureContent (text code points only), pruneContent (copy-on-write head/marker/tail slicing), and pruneSession which appends a compaction/prune shadow-price event synchronously immediately before each replacement; preserves call id, step, error, metadata and unknown future fields.
Pruner vocabulary: ToolResultPruneConfig, ResolvedConfig, PrunedEntry (keeps the original callId so pairing needs no side map) and PruneResult with aggregate charsRemoved.

Real Loader composition from a temp YAML; asserts the resolved config and that the stale key maxChars is rejected after schema normalisation (noting config normalisation only runs once the declared injections are satisfied).

Pruner tests: an independent TokenMeter "pricing oracle" asserts the shadow-price event sits IMMEDIATELY before the replacement with the correct price; a logged image offload survives a later prune and a restore; a second pass converges to zero; replay yields identical messages.
17-line project config; the smallest reference set in the family (llm/llm, llm/token-meter, core/session, ../compaction).
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction v0.2.1-rc.2; exports three entry points (. , ./types, ./checkpoint) so client/wire programs can import the marker without pulling in the Context merge.
Per-section bilingual hash record for the seam README; tool-pairing-boundaries and locking-and-serialization are separately gated blocks.

Shared compaction contract: three abstract operations, the log-recorded bracket as the lock (a crash leaves a detectable orphan, not a false success), the surface contract, the manual failure taxonomy, and the tool-pairing boundary rules.
Chinese translation of the seam contract; preserves the 标记对 (bracket pair) metaphor and adds a bolded emphasis that the replacement sits INSIDE the lock bracket.
Branded CompactionId type and minting function (CompactionId(randomUUID())); explicitly performs no validation — a 13-line Cordis-free leaf.

Cordis-free compact-checkpoint message source: constructor, type and isCompactCheckpointSource predicate, so client and wire programs can recognise condensed history without loading the host plugin's Context merges.

Abstract CompactionEngine service, ctx.compaction merge, CompactionTrigger, ManualCompactionError with the closed code set (busy|cancelled|changed|summary|commit|persistence), and the synchronous compaction/summary-error waterfall whose listeners may return true only after recording durable progress.

Per-session cut-balance cache (WeakMap keyed on replaceGeneration) behind toolPairingBalancedBefore/After; balance derived from tool-call/result content in CURRENT surface order, validated tail-before-mutate so a corrupt surface cannot leave partial state.

The compaction/* session-event vocabulary and CompactionResult; documents the shadow-price protocol on compaction/prune (the metering event must be immediately followed by the replacement) and that shadowedRange is a surface-POSITION span whose start can exceed end.

Seam contract tests: ctx.compaction registration and fiber-dispose unregistration (HMR safety), signal threading to all three operations, and that compaction/* events are log-only (no surfaceOp) with the checkpoint source correlated.

Balance-cache tests pinning exact event-read counts (3,3,3,4,6,7) to prove cached cuts read no events, log-only growth causes no reads, replace rebuilds, and orphan tool results throw without committing partial cache state.
Project config whose reference list is exactly the seam's declared dependency surface (util/brand, vendor/cosmokit, vendor/cordis, llm/llm, interaction/commands, core/session).

The family's only tsdown build config: one self-contained entry for lib/types/index.js with codeSplitting:false, clean:false and dts:false so the declaration output and the package whitelist both survive.
Per-section bilingual hash record for the family index (25 lines).
Package-group map of the five compaction packages with their ctx keys, and the note that token measurement deliberately lives in a separate LLM-family service.
Chinese translation of the family map; keeps ctx key names untranslated and translates the concept (压缩能力家族, 表层 for surface) consistently.
